headline: Base Flips Surge Across Western Front
war_summary: Day 128 of War 140 shows the strategic map still split: Colonials dominate the western and southern arcs while Wardens hold the northern and eastern sectors. The most volatile sector remains Fishermans Row, which recorded thirty‑three ownership changes in the past twenty‑four hours, the latest at 23:53 Z. Lykos Isle follows with twenty‑one flips, last noted at 23:53 Z. Weathered Expanse added eighteen flips, its newest event stamped at the current cutoff. Stlican Shelf has twelve daily flips, the most recent at 22:25 Z, while Oarbreaker logged seven, latest at 23:10 Z. Godcrofts saw six flips, the last occurring moments ago. Casualty streams are accelerating on Linn Mercy, Loch Mor, Marban Hollow, Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf and Oarbreaker, indicating intensifying combat, whereas Clahstra, Callahans Passage, Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse are cooling. Enlistment rates are rising in several contested regions, especially Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf, suggesting fresh troop arrivals. No strategic bases have changed hands on the quiet fronts such as Acrithia, Allods Bight or the deep Warden‑held interior.
